snippet.title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter arrives Fall 2026!

The next modern reimagining of the Trails series debuts in full 3D! Continue your 1st Chapter journey with brand-new combat options, expansive side content, and an unforgettable story. 

Coming to Steam, PS5, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2!
www.trails2ndchapter.com 
#Trails2ndChapter
